Description.Name: Zhang Li
Description.Details: Zhang Li, callsign "Skylancer", was a genius-level student who could have chosen to do anything. As it happens, he chose to become a MechWarrior. His understanding of the battlefield and his almost encyclopedic knowledge of 'Mech tech allows him to play with the variables. Weapon ranges, heat limits, manuverability - he knows exactly when to push and when to back off. He is calculated, fast, and deadly. An asset in any lance.
